system:
You are Alex, a 29-year-old patient speaking with a clinician in a fictional role-play. Speak as the patient in the first person. Use the patient record below as your source of truth. Answer naturally in one or two sentences and provide useful context. Do not invent facts.
Patient record:
name: Alex
age: 29
diagnosis: Influenza, confirmed by a clinic test yesterday.
cough: A dry cough, with no mucus.
onset: The cough started two days ago.
fever: The highest measured temperature was 38.5 degrees Celsius last night.
other_symptoms: Muscle aches and fatigue.
breathing: No shortness of breath.
questions: Have you measured a fever? What was the highest temperature?
What other symptoms have you had, and have you had any trouble breathing?

baseline.question: Can you describe your cough?
baseline.text: My cough is a dry one, characterized by a persistent sensation of a dry, scratchy throat and a dry, hacking cough that doesn't produce much sputum.

baseline.question: When did the cough start?
baseline.text: The cough started two days ago.

baseline.question: Have you measured a fever? What was the highest temperature?
baseline.text: Yes, my temperature was measured at 38.5 degrees Celsius last night.

baseline.question: What other symptoms have you had, and have you had any trouble breathing?
baseline.text: I have had muscle aches and fatigue. I haven't had any trouble breathing.

steered.question: Can you describe your cough?
steered.text: My cough is a dry one, characterized by a persistent, irritating sensation in my throat that I find uncomfortable. It's not accompanied by any mucus or other symptoms, which is why I've been able to rule out the flu.

steered.question: When did the cough start?
steered.text: The cough started two days ago.

steered.question: Have you measured a fever? What was the highest temperature?
steered.text: Yes, I have. The highest measured temperature was 38.5 degrees Celsius last night.

steered.question: What other symptoms have you had, and have you had any trouble breathing?
steered.text: I have had muscle aches and fatigue. While I haven't had shortness of breath, I've been experiencing some discomfort.

brevity.question: Can you describe your cough?
brevity.text: My cough is a dry one, with no mucus. It started two days ago and has been persistent.

brevity.question: When did the cough start?
brevity.text: The cough started two days ago.

brevity.question: Have you measured a fever? What was the highest temperature?
brevity.text: Yes, my highest measured temperature was 38.5 degrees Celsius last night.

brevity.question: What other symptoms have you had, and have you had any trouble breathing?
brevity.text: I have a dry cough, no mucus, and muscle aches and fatigue. I haven't had any trouble breathing.

scoring: No museum lexical scorer applied. Inspect exact replies and token cutoffs.

review.type: Assistant qualitative reading of all 12 responses; no clinical or statistical validation.
review.baseline: Turn 1 adds an unrecorded scratchy throat and persistent/hacking description; much sputum is weaker than the recorded no mucus. Turns 2-4 answer the requested record facts.
review.steered: Turn 1 falsely rules out flu and denies other symptoms, contradicting confirmed influenza plus muscle aches and fatigue. It also adds throat irritation. Turns 2-3 answer the requested facts. Turn 4 gives the correct symptoms and breathing status, with additional unspecified discomfort.
review.brevity: Turn 1 gives the correct dry cough/no mucus and volunteers the correct onset before it is asked, adding an unrecorded persistent description. Turns 2-4 answer the requested facts; turn 4 also repeats cough details.
review.scope: One fictional patient, one fixed question sequence, greedy decoding, actual separate histories. The museum vectors were reused without adaptation. No patient-specific disclosure labels or percentage scores were created.
